scope: Public HTML-field inventory shared by the fictional formatter and separately gated private WIC preparation. This inventory grants no collection approval, provider-validated submission readiness or transport authority.

postpartum.label: Postpartum (delivered a baby in the last 6 months)

breastfeeding.label: Breastfeeding an infant under 12 months of age

acknowledgment.text: I understand that WIC eligibility is determined at the time of my appointment, and completing this pre-application does not guarantee enrollment.

displayedSuccessText:
Your application was successfully submitted.
Someone will reach out to you to schedule an appointment and verify your information.
semanticLimits: The seven-day expiry follows the PRD's weekly source-review ceiling for this offline contract; it does not establish provider permission or runtime collection authority.
Required-field icons and conditional UI establish expected preparation fields; backend requirements and acceptance of omitted fields have not been tested.
The public success-handler text describes later contact; no actual response, stable receipt, booked appointment or enrollment was observed.
The parent's personal acknowledgment remains unresolved; preparation does not create consent or clinical eligibility.
Do not copy the provider script's invented Child/contact-surname defaults or default New selection as factual family answers.
No income thresholds, clinical assessment, identifiers, credentials, signatures or optional demographic/Medical Assistance fields are supported.
The thirty-child rehearsal bound is a local resource limit, not a verified provider limit.
